title: Translation Circuit Discovery and Targeted Optimization for Low-Resource Multilingual Translation
abstract: arXiv:2610.21456v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recent multilingual large language models achieve strong translation performance, yet the internal mechanisms responsible for low-resource multilingual translation remain insufficiently understood. In this paper, we study translation circuits in multilingual decoder-only LLMs for Hindi-to-Urdu and Hindi-to-Sindhi (Devanagari). We propose TITAN, a mechanistic framework that combines causal intervention, sparse feature decomposition, and targeted preference optimization to identify and optimize crucial translation components in the transformer. Unlike conventional full-parameter fine-tuning, TITAN restricts optimization to sparse, causally important circuits, enabling scalable and parameter-efficient adaptation while updating fewer than 5% of model parameters. Experimental results show that TITAN achieves BLEU improvements of 33.75% on Hindi-to-Urdu and 45.86% on Hindi-to-Sindhi over the strongest multilingual baselines. Human expert evalu

translated_title: 面向低资源多语言翻译的翻译电路发现与针对性优化
translated_abstract: 近期的多语言大语言模型已展现出强大的翻译性能，但其负责低资源多语言翻译的内部机制仍未被充分理解。在本文中，我们研究了多语言仅解码器大语言模型中印地语到乌尔都语以及印地语到信德语（天城文）的翻译电路。我们提出了TITAN，一个结合了因果干预、稀疏特征分解和针对性偏好优化的机制分析框架，用于识别和优化Transformer中关键的翻译组件。与传统的全参数微调不同，TITAN将优化限制在稀疏且具有因果重要性的电路上，在更新不到5%模型参数的情况下，实现了可扩展且参数高效的适配。实验结果表明，与最强的多语言基线相比，TITAN在印地语到乌尔都语翻译上实现了33.75%的BLEU提升，在印地语到信德语翻译上实现了45.86%的BLEU提升。人类专家评估（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: TITAN框架通过因果干预、稀疏特征分解与针对性偏好优化，仅更新不到5%的参数即可识别并优化多语言大模型中的关键翻译电路，使印地语到乌尔都语和信德语的低资源翻译BLEU分别提升33.75%和45.86%。
en_tdlr: TITAN identifies and optimizes causally important translation circuits in multilingual LLMs via causal intervention, sparse feature decomposition, and targeted preference optimization, boosting low-resource Hindi-to-Urdu and Hindi-to-Sindhi translation BLEU by 33.75% and 45.86% while updating less than 5% of model parameters.
